scripts.copy-sw: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');const src=path.resolve('node_modules/webtorrent/dist/sw.min.js');const dest=path.resolve('public/sw.min.js');if(!fs.existsSync(src)){console.error('WebTorrent service worker not found: '+src);process.exit(1)}fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(dest),{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);console.log('Copied WebTorrent service worker to public/sw.min.js')"
